dialogue.context: Existing dialogue. After winning the optional sailor battle.

lines.speaker: Nell
lines.text: Those little birds will brave a gale for each other. I try to be worthy of that.

description: A sailor who offers a voluntary friendly challenge when off watch. After defeat she speaks of little birds braving a gale for each other and trying to be worthy of them. Her affection for companions is expressed through work at sea.

sections: §30: working harbour, optional sailors and the planned island crossing.

name: Nell
